D008_m001.question:
Well, Doc, thanks for seeing me. It’s been… rough. For the past month or so, I’ve been running on fumes, but not feeling tired, if that makes sense. I’d be up all night, plotting out new fishing routes, sketching new designs for the boat, feeling like I could conquer the sea. My wife, bless her, says I’m talking a mile a minute, jumping from one idea to the next. One minute I’m buzzing with energy, feeling on top of the world, and the next, I snap at her for the smallest thing. My mind just races, like a thousand thoughts all screaming for attention, and I can't seem to rein it in. Focusing on anything, even casting a net, feels impossible these days.

Before this, for about two months, it was like the life had been sucked right out of me. I just couldn't drum up the energy to do anything, felt like a lead weight. Even getting out of bed to go to work felt like climbing Mount Everest. And the guilt… I keep replaying every mistake I’ve ever made, every little thing I messed up. It’s exhausting, this constant feeling of being worn out, even after a full night's sleep. It's really affecting my work and my home life.
D008_m001.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    B. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    C. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    D. Bipolar I Disorder
